mcqs.question: Which observance was marked on 25 June 2025 to commemorate 50 years of the Emergency imposed in 1975?
mcqs.explanation: Samvidhan Hatya Diwas was observed on 25 June 2025 to mark 50 years of the Emergency of 1975. International Day of Yoga was observed on 21 June, while Passport Seva Divas was held from 23–25 June.
